engine_build.runtime_prerequisites: Linux/glibc, libstdc++, and the matching CUDA or ROCm toolkit and driver; see README.md

adapter.source: Same checkout and pinned llama.cpp; frontend source unchanged from 39f8ea516be1. Independently built CPU-only unbiased-strata, not substituted with Maya's server.

inputs.tokenizer_template_identity: Embedded in the full-file-hashed model, with unchanged frontend compatibility transformations; no drafter, projector or derived pack.

numerical.reference: Retained CPU/double references and exact fused/unfused assertions, with original tolerances unchanged; scalar and vector FP8 finite-byte checks include negative zero.
numerical.blas_reference: Independent CPU double sums over the actual float/half inputs; tolerance 2e-4 + 2e-5 * abs(reference). Full FP32 default math, no XF32 request.

measurements.startup_conditions: After input SHA-256 verification; OS page cache warm, not a cold-disk startup benchmark.

safety.confinement: Only selected renderD128 and KFD exposed; repaired ROCr mapped read-only; private PID/network namespaces; loopback-only API; exclusive existing runtime coordination lease.

corrections.observed: Initial native run failed exact FP8 negative-zero preservation and fused MoE/conv rounding by one float ULP.
corrections.fix: Direct unit-scale FP8 bit conversion and HIP statement-local FMA contraction; original parity assertions retained and scalar coverage added.

corrections.observed: First real-model request hit hipBLAS status 7 on HIPBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_PEDANTIC; that run reached the 15-minute envelope timeout.
corrections.fix: Use supported full-FP32 default math, independently verified against double products; add per-completion wall-clock limits.

corrections.observed: One later envelope stopped in preflight while restored ComfyUI's HTTP service was still starting; no model payload launched.
corrections.fix: Bounded readiness wait before checking its idle queue; no kernel incident was inferred.

existing_support.unchanged: Existing release records, Qwen engine/shared HIP shim, frontend and llama.cpp gitlink; no affected shared inference behavior changed.

limits: Exact selected model/runtime/device/configuration only; fresh candidates retain unqualified build metadata until their evidence is accepted.
Not a release publication, general AMD qualification, vision/drafting/multi-GPU support or 96K+ coding-model qualification.
No whole-model logit/KL equivalence or broad quality benchmark; useful task outcomes and operator references are separate evidence.
Tools were naturally generated and parsed successfully; this engine does not enforce a JSON grammar or guarantee arbitrary tool_choice constraints.
Host RSS may double-count shared mappings, summed HWM is an upper bound, device VRAM includes desktop allocations, and 50-ms sampled device peaks can miss transients.

hardware_capacity.method: Kernel sysfs and /proc observations; available memory is an observation, not a reservation.

reconstruction_verification.result: A second fresh source-controlled candidate build produced the byte-identical qualified engine and retained the complete qualification documentation; build metadata still starts unqualified.
